gen-mystery-quest-gf-miriam-libre: Miriam Libre draws its sans letters like bent wire, with generous openings in the s and stout, cast-iron lowercase height. Mystery Quest adds bookish, nostalgic display flavor while the body carries on plainly.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-mozilla-text: Bookish, nostalgic Mystery Quest leads with open-jawed curves on every round stroke. Mozilla Text brings flared terminals and a bold-looking lowercase, so it needs only modest size to hold its own.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-noto-sans-adlam: Noto Sans Adlam keeps its curve endings well apart, giving clean, contemporary text with full-bodied c, s and z. Mystery Quest is best at bookish, nostalgic display moments, whereas the sans-serif is best at running text.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-noto-sans-arabic: Clean and modern, Noto Sans Arabic opens up its small letters wide. Mystery Quest adds bookish, nostalgic jaws on its curves, and the sans-serif text, with its pronounced x-height, lets that flavor stand alone.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-noto-sans-armenian: Bookish and nostalgic, Mystery Quest does its best work at display size, jaws open on every curve. Noto Sans Armenian does the text-setting job, with full-bodied c, s and z and wide round openings.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-noto-sans-avestan: Noto Sans Avestan keeps its curve tips from touching, a modern, clean sans-serif with a pronounced x-height. Noto Sans Avestan is the plain-spoken half, letting Mystery Quest and its open-jawed nostalgia stand out.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-noto-sans-bassa-vah: Reading in Noto Sans Bassa Vah feels contemporary and businesslike, with a dominant midsection and an open-jawed c like pliers. Mystery Quest supplies the bookish, nostalgic display voice on top.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-noto-sans-batak: Mystery Quest is best at bookish, nostalgic display moments, with open jaws on every curve. Noto Sans Batak handles running text, where its towering x-height and generous e never look squeezed.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-noto-sans-bhaiksuki: Noto Sans Bhaiksuki packs coiled-rope fullness into its letters while keeping its apertures readily legible. But Mystery Quest, bookish and nostalgic, gives the page its antique flourish, and the text holds firm.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-noto-sans-brahmi: Noto Sans Brahmi lifts its mean line and leaves every curved letter open-ended, a contemporary, understated sans voice. Shrink Mystery Quest and its open jaws and bookish charm get lost.
